title: Value-Added Services — The Yearly RideLink Allotment
content:
This statement fixes the number of Non-Emergency Medical Transportation value-added trips loaded for a benefit year.

**Which year.** The year loaded is the current benefit year: the calendar year of the load.

**Formal clause.** The January load is the level's yearly value-added trips, loaded in full for the whole year.

The level's yearly value-added trips are the figure the RideLink level lists in its value-added trip summary.

## Worked examples

*Hypothetical loads:*

| Level's yearly value-added trips | Trips loaded for the year |
|---|---|
| 24 | 24 |
| 12 | 12 |

*Hypothetical:* a benefit on a level with 24 yearly value-added trips has its 2027 allotment load entry record benefit year 2027 and 24 trips.
